name: Jasmine Latendresse
title: PhD in Software Engineering
bio:
I am a Postdoctoral Researcher in Software Engineering at Concordia University, working with Emad Shihab in the DAS Lab. I am also a graduate of CREATE SE4AI, an NSERC-funded training program.

My research focuses on empirical software engineering, software ecosystems and dependency management, and AI-assisted software development. I also contribute to the Concordia University–National Bank of Canada research partnership, where my current work focuses on AI agents and agentic systems for software engineering and enterprise applications.
